capability.summary: Run one lxml XPath expression against one local XML file
capability.description: Parses a local XML document with lxml, evaluates one XPath expression without caller-supplied namespace bindings or variables, normalizes list items to strings (serializing element nodes), and returns the matches in a JSON envelope.
capability.problem_space: One-off XPath selection or scalar evaluation over an existing local XML document. It is distinct from XML-to-JSON tree conversion and is not XSLT, XSD/DTD validation, namespace-aware query configuration, remote XML querying, XML mutation, or a hardened untrusted-XML service.

constraint.io_signature: Input: required file_path string at CLI position 1 and required xpath_query string at position 2. Output: JSON envelope with xpath, match_count, and a list of string-normalized results; element results are serialized XML strings.
accepted_inputs: an existing local, well-formed XML file plus one lxml-supported XPath expression requiring no external namespace map or variables
constraint.output_shape: Success: {status: "success", tool: "lxml", target: string, xpath: string, match_count: integer, matches: [string, ...]}, exit 0. Node-set/list results yield one normalized string per item; element nodes use etree.tostring(..., encoding="unicode").strip(), while non-elements use str(). A scalar XPath result is wrapped as one string, so match_count is 1 even for false/empty-string/numeric scalars. Non-existing path: {status: "error", message: string}, exit 2. XMLSyntaxError or XPathError: {status: "error", tool: "lxml", message: string}, exit 1. Missing arguments print usage to stderr and exit 1 without JSON; other exceptions may traceback.
limitations: parses the complete XML document and materializes the complete XPath result list and normalized strings in memory; input, match count, subtree size, and result size are unbounded with possible memory amplification
has no output truncation and no timeout; broad XPath expressions or large documents can produce very large results or run without a time limit

passes no namespace-prefix mapping, variables, extension-function policy, or smart-string options; prefixed queries fail unless resolvable without caller configuration, so namespace-heavy XML may require local-name() expressions

all results lose native XPath types: booleans, numbers, and strings become strings, scalar results always become a one-item matches list, and element serialization may include subtree markup and tail text
uses lxml's default XML parser without explicit entity, DTD, recovery, size, depth, or network-hardening settings; do not treat it as a hardened untrusted-XML boundary
does not modify XML, return source-node locations, convert the whole document to JSON, or catch non-XMLSyntaxError/non-XPathError failures

output_contract.description: JSON envelope containing the XPath expression, string-normalized matches, and match count, or a handled XML/XPath error.

json_schema.description: Native JSON representation only; no field or task-delivery guarantee.

negative_intents: convert an entire XML document to JSON
